mapper.select: SELECT id,username,password_hash,display_name FROM app_user WHERE username=#{username}
SELECT id,username,password_hash,display_name FROM app_user WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT u.id,u.username,u.display_name FROM app_user u WHERE (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') OR u.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_member m WHERE m.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.user_id=u.id) ORDER BY u.id LIMIT 20
